dimensions.assessment: Directly affects up to six designated node entities, researchers using the network, and federal agencies like the National Science Foundation and the National Institute of Standards and Technology.
dimensions.evidence: designate and oversee a National Programmable Cloud Laboratories Network of not more than 6 nodes

dimensions.assessment: Provides up to $5,000,000 per fiscal year per node for up to five years, creating structured remote experimentation and automation capabilities.
dimensions.evidence: award a grant to each node, in an amount not greater than $5,000,000 per fiscal year for a period of not more than 5 years

dimensions.assessment: Allocates $30,000,000 for each of the fiscal years 2026 through 2030 to carry out the Act.
dimensions.evidence: allocate $30,000,000 for each of the fiscal years 2026 through 2030 to carry out this Act

dimensions.assessment: Establishes statutory authority for a new network program, interagency standards, and comprehensive assessments of non-designated laboratories.
dimensions.evidence: establishes statutory authority for a national programmable cloud laboratories program established by the National Science Foundation

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes funding and programs through fiscal years 2026 to 2030, with a complete sunset on September 30, 2031.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes a national programmable cloud laboratories network through the National Science Foundation, allocating up to $30,000,000 annually from fiscal years 2026 through 2030 and designating up to six nodes. It also mandates interoperability standards and an assessment of non-designated laboratories.
